all_clues_monologue: That's enough. Victor's access was real, and wrong for his job. He opened a folder that was not his, and 2 GB left for a personal cloud.
I know what he did. I do not know why. Time to press REPORT and sort what we know from what we do not.

report.solved_explanation: This is an insider threat: a person with real access who uses it the wrong way, on purpose or by mistake. The access was real, so look at what the person does, and give each person only the access the job needs.
